hero.description: Mimo (/miˈmoʊ/) is an open-source avatar system that generates unique characters from any string. Unlike traditional avatars, every Mimo is fully animated — blinking, floating, glancing — right out of the box. 145,152 unique combinations ensure no two avatars look alike.

quickStart.title: Quick Start
quickStart.intro: Try it out — enter a name, adjust the options, and watch the avatar update live. Drop it into your project with the API or React component.
quickStart.apiDescription: Generate avatars as SVG over HTTP. The name is the URL path — all options go in the query string.
quickStart.reactDescription: Import the Mimo component and pass a name string. Props match the API parameters.

deterministic.title: Deterministic
deterministic.description: Avatars are derived from a hash of the input string — the same name always produces the same face. Fully deterministic, with nothing stored or fetched.

combinations.title: 145,152 Combinations
combinations.description: Faces are assembled from 6 eye styles × 4 eyebrow types × 7 mouths × 2 cheek options × 3 accessories × 16 colors × 9 rotations.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description:
Sixteen soft pastel gradients with radial rendering for a subtle 3D appearance.

Pass in a custom gradients array to use your own palette.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Variants are pluggable visual styles. Each variant defines its own set of props — mood, animations, detailLevel, and more. Pass a variant factory directly or pre-configure it with a descriptor.

moods.title: Moods
moods.description: Set a mood to give the avatar a specific expression, regardless of the generated features.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Pass an animations array to bring avatars to life. All animations are CSS-based and injected on demand — combine freely. Pass a string for defaults, or an object with type, delay, and duration for custom timing.

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: Choose between a circle, squircle, or square clip for the avatar.

depthEffects.title: 3D Effects
depthEffects.description: Four depth levels for CSS 3D perspective transforms. The face tilts based on the deterministic rotation. In React, the face flattens on hover when interactive is enabled.

detailLevels.title: Detail Levels
detailLevels.description: Feature visibility automatically adapts to size. Smaller avatars show fewer features for clarity. Override with the detailLevel prop.

customGradients.title: Custom Gradients
customGradients.description: Replace the default palette with your own gradient pairs via the gradients prop. The API accepts hex pairs like E8D5F5-C7A4E0,FFE0D0-FFB899.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Props and API params share the same names. In the API, name is the URL path — all others are query params.

rows.name: Input string for deterministic generation. API: URL path segment.
rows.size: Avatar dimensions in pixels. React default: 40. API default: 128.
rows.shape: Avatar clipping shape. Squircle uses Apple-style continuous curvature.
rows.variant: Variant plugin to use for rendering.
rows.detailLevel: Feature visibility level. Adapts to size by default.
rows.animations: String or object with type, delay, and duration. API: comma-separated values.
rows.gradients: Custom gradient palette. API: hex pairs like E8D5F5-C7A4E0,FFE0D0-FFB899.

footer.description: Everything runs in your browser. No images, no data, nothing stored or sent.
